purpose: Keep selected reference content available to the fresh comparative evaluator while preventing generator or optimizer access to reference text that could enable answer-shaping or imitation.
rules: materialize only references selected by the frozen reference-selection stage
reject references marked refresh_required before bundle materialization
copy full selected reference content only into the evaluator-only bundle
record bundle-local hashes for every materialized reference
validate a non-empty reference set, hashes, allowlist, denylist and evaluator-only scope before comparative evaluation
do not expose evaluator bundle files or reference excerpts to generator or optimizer responsibilities
sanitize comparative defects before optimizer handoff so remediation guidance does not contain reference text or hidden expected output
